name: Kikou Masou Shoujo Mizuki ~Toraware no Dennou Shoujo~
original_name: 機甲魔装少女ミヅキ -囚われの電脳少女-
source:
While Mizuki is using her parents computer she is drawn into the world inside the video game! Unable to escape she must team up with magical girl Kurou in her fight against Bugs, evil technological monsters who wish to rape and impregnate our heroines!

Mizuki must become a magical girl like Kurou and fight back against the Bugs, but can she succeed or is her fate inside the game already sealed?
